reason: 该插件的核心面向用途是面向 DSH 智能体会话的行为编排与启动管理：它通过安装并应用 agent preset，在主代理与子代理的首轮请求阶段执行最小化工具/提示约束，再在指定触发条件后恢复完整工具集，并统一处理子代理的 persona 继承与恢复流程。该归类依据来自 README 中的引导流程说明、配置字段和测试覆盖范围说明，且缺乏网络、账户接入或外部服务凭据操作的直接证据。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH 提供代理预设，令主代理与子代理在首轮以最小工具与 Minimal 人设启动，并在首个稳定交互后切换为完整工具集合。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a DSH agent preset that starts main and subagents in a minimal bootstrap persona/tool set, then promotes them to the full tool catalog after the first durable interaction.

capabilities: Configures a session preset that changes initial agent/tool behavior for main and subagents
Limits first-turn tools to a bootstrap set, then promotes to a full tool catalog
Strips and later restores subagent persona settings during handoff
Enables tool-capable interactions (including shell tool usage) within the DSH environment

reasons.code: README states the plugin installs an agent preset that starts with only bash + str_replace_editor and Minimal persona, then restores the full catalog after first durable turn.
README explains DSH subagents inherit the parent agent preset, so the plugin affects subagent session initialization behavior.
README documents that subagent custom persona is stripped before first request and re-registered after promotion, which is direct behavior-modifying logic.
Package metadata exposes a DSH bundle patch and preset assets, confirming runtime installation/integration in DSH.
